_comment: The dealer's voice while the read runs — Add Item Ideas 4d. Reviewed copy, not model output. Slot one is a bench line; slots two and three prefer object lines and upgrade to lookup lines when the value has landed; the last slot may take ONE wink per read, never on a flagged or failed read, never on a collector's first. Lines in winks_held are written but held for the owner's call and are never played. Lookup templates only fire when their placeholders are already computed — never a query on the critical path. Lines never claim value or price.
